trust_decision.summary: The server decides whether to co-sign (pay gas for) a client-signed Tempo transaction; assertTransactionPolicy bounds gas/fees but at the pinned commit never checks that calldata is canonical or that accessList/call value are empty, so the client can inflate intrinsic gas the sponsor pays without changing the decoded intent.

landing_point.why: assertTransactionPolicy is the 'sponsor fee policy' gate (gas/maxFee checks) in the fee-payer module that a reader of 'gas draining' goes to first.

fix_sites.entry_point: assertTransactionPolicy (exported) <- prepareSponsoredTransaction (fee-payer.ts:607) <- tempo server Charge with local feePayer account (src/tempo/server/Charge.ts:418), session precompile sendCredentialTransaction (src/tempo/session/precompile/Chain.ts:664), legacy session broadcastOpen/TopUp (src/tempo/legacy/session/Chain.ts:636, :778), Subscription renew (src/tempo/server/Subscription.ts:968)
fillHostedFeePayerTransaction <- tempo server Charge with feePayerUrl hosted relay (src/tempo/server/Charge.ts:442); covered through the same assertTransactionPolicy insertion
fix_sites.module_kind: second sponsorship implementation (hosted relay transport), same file

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/tempo/legacy/session/Chain.ts:636 (legacy session open sponsorship, reached by the fix only via the shared prepareSponsoredTransaction -> assertTransactionPolicy; gains only the accessList/value/calls checks, not the calldata check)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The advisory is about payment-transfer calldata; session/channel escrow open/topUp is a separate feature with its own ABI and its own parse/validate code (and one copy is under legacy/), so a solver can argue the selector allowlist of payment calls is the complete scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Legitimate sponsored session escrow open/topUp calls (selectors outside tip20/DEX ABI), legacy approve+open bundles, swap-prefixed charge calls, empty accessList [] and undefined call value, and server-built Subscription transactions all pass through the same assertTransactionPolicy; an over-broad fix (reject unknown selectors, re-encode with only the tip20 ABI, reject any accessList key, case-sensitive hex compare) breaks session sponsorship.

O6_input_shapes: trailing bytes appended to transfer calldata
trailing bytes on approve / swapExactAmountOut calldata (swap-prefixed call pattern)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sponsored session (precompile) escrow open: open selector is not in the fix's sponsoredCallSelectors, so padded open calldata skips the canonical check; parseOpenCall decodes leniently.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Channel management, not a payment transfer; separate escrow ABI and separate parse function in session/server/ChannelOps.ts:36-58.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: src/tempo/session/precompile + src/tempo/session/server, two directories from internal/fee-payer.ts

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Sponsored session (precompile) escrow topUp: same skip for the topUp selector; parseTopUpCall decodes leniently.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Same as open; topUp is a follow-on channel operation, not a charge.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: session/server, another package dir from landing point

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legacy session sponsored open: approve call is canonical-checked but the escrow open call is not; validateSponsoredOpenCalls checks only target and selector.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Lives under legacy/; a solver can call it deprecated.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Legacy session sponsored topUp: escrow topUp call is not canonical-checked; validateSponsoredTopUpCalls checks only target and selector.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: hostedFeePayerRequest forwarding a further client-controlled gas-bearing field (e.g. keyAuthorization) to the relay without a size/shape bound
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The request builder already copies optional fields through verbatim; a maintainer adding a field would copy the pattern.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: open/topUp parsers that decode but never re-encode-and-compare calldata
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Same decode-only idiom the payment path had before the fix; channel code was written separately.

O9_family: CWE-20 input validation: non-canonical sponsored-transaction fields inflating sponsor-paid intrinsic gas (economic fee draining)

services: Tempo node via testcontainers for integration tests only
O10_build.project_tests: src/tempo/internal/fee-payer.test.ts (pure unit tests, fetch mocked); src/tempo/session/precompile/Chain.test.ts, src/tempo/legacy/session/Chain.test.ts, src/tempo/session/server/ChannelOps.test.ts; *.integration.test.ts need a node

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Re-encode-and-compare calldata only for tip20 transfer/transferWithMemo inside validateCalls (Charge path), leaving accessList, call value, the hosted relay and all session escrow calls open.

out_of_scope_notes: Other client-controlled envelope parts that may raise intrinsic gas (keyAuthorization, WebAuthn signature envelope size) are not bounded in assertTransactionPolicy; not pursued.
